C · MANAGER — drives Q&A and Report modes
single fixed agent · routes both modes to a grounded answer / report
one Base Agent + domain skill + pillar YAML
Q&A mode → Manager selects N of 7 domains (dynamic)
Report mode → invokes ALL pillar specialists in parallel, each runs report_generation
7 domains: bureau · crossbu · modeling · spend_payments · wcc · customer_rel · capacity_afford
ReportSpec + team results return to the Manager — synthesis merges them
→ returns FinalAnswer to ChatAgent and Case Report to ReportAgent (top ↑)
D · DATA LAYER — Table Agents own & maintain the Shared Data Catalog
a few grouped Table Agents — each owns a table group, keeps it healthy, and publishes a high-quality catalog entry (data_maintenance · data_catalog_sync)
union of per-table entries (11 tables) · read by Manager (team_construction) & specialists (data_query)
